{
  "edition_title": "September 2026 Edition: Build Now, Nigeria's Ecosystem Is Wide Open",
  "edition_intro": "Ambitious young Nigerians, this month's list rewards people who move fast: a fully funded master's in Beijing, a nine-figure naira startup fund straight from the Federal Ministry of Youth Development, and free certification vouchers that cost you nothing but effort. None of these charge a fee to apply. Read the deadlines carefully, some close in days, and get your applications in.",
  "opportunities": [
    {
      "category": "scholarships",
      "title": "Schwarzman Scholars 2027-2028 Cohort",
      "summary": "A fully funded one-year Master's in Global Affairs at Tsinghua University in Beijing, covering tuition, travel, housing, and a stipend.",
      "deadline": "9 September 2026",
      "eligibility": "Bachelor's degree holders aged 18 to 28 by 1 August 2027, from any country including Nigeria, applying under the global/US track",
      "apply_url": "https://www.schwarzmanscholars.org/admissions/application-instructions/",
      "body_md": "Schwarzman Scholars is one of the most competitive fully funded master's programs in the world, built to put rising leaders from across the globe in direct contact with China's role in shaping the next century. Scholars live and study together at Tsinghua University for a year, take classes in leadership, economics, and international affairs, and graduate into a lifelong network of Schwarzman alumni now working across government, finance, and technology.\n\nThe program covers everything: tuition, room and board, a laptop, travel to and from Beijing, and an in-country study trip. Late applications are never accepted, so if you have an undergraduate degree and want a credential that opens doors in both East and West, this is worth clearing your calendar for before the 9 September deadline."
    },
    {
      "category": "grants",
      "title": "NiYA Startup Pitch 2.0",
      "summary": "A Federal Ministry of Youth Development initiative putting a ₦100 million funding pool behind 100 youth-led Nigerian tech startups, plus mentorship and enterprise tools.",
      "deadline": "Rolling",
      "eligibility": "Nigerians aged 18 to 35, with at least two co-founders and a registered NiYA community profile",
      "apply_url": "https://niya.gov.ng/niyastartup",
      "body_md": "NiYA Startup Pitch 2.0 is the Nigerian Youth Academy's follow-up to its first funding cycle, and it's built specifically to find the next wave of youth-led tech founders outside the usual Lagos-only circuit. Applicants need a working team (at least two co-founders), a pitch deck, and a completed NiYA profile; selected startups get a share of the ₦100 million pool alongside structured mentorship and nationwide visibility.\n\nBecause this is a federal government initiative run on niya.gov.ng, there is no application fee and reviews happen on a rolling basis, so earlier, well-prepared submissions have an edge. If you have a working prototype and co-founders ready to go, this is a direct, no-nonsense route to capital and a national platform.",
      "note": null
    },
    {
      "category": "conferences",
      "title": "GITEX Nigeria 2026",
      "summary": "West Africa's largest tech expo and AI summit, free to attend, running in Lagos and Abuja through 3 September 2026.",
      "deadline": "3 September 2026",
      "eligibility": "Open to all; free visitor registration required",
      "apply_url": "https://visit.gitexnigeria.ng/",
      "body_md": "GITEX Nigeria is the West African edition of the global GITEX tech show franchise, bringing government officials, investors, founders, and global tech leaders together to talk AI, cloud, and the future economy. It runs from 31 August to 3 September 2026 across Lagos and Abuja, and visitor registration is completely free.\n\nFor a young builder, this is less about the keynote stage and more about the floor: the founders, recruiters, and investors walking between booths who you would otherwise need a warm introduction to reach. Registration closes with the event, so if you're in or can get to Lagos or Abuja this week, it costs nothing but a signup to get in the room."
    },
    {
      "category": "conferences",
      "title": "Wetech Conference 2026: The Power Shift",
      "summary": "Africa's largest gathering for women in tech, bringing 2,500+ founders, investors, and operators together in Lagos to talk AI, capital, and leadership.",
      "deadline": "26 September 2026",
      "eligibility": "Open registration; women in tech and allies across the African tech ecosystem",
      "apply_url": "https://event.wetech.africa/",
      "body_md": "Wetech has built itself into the continent's flagship event for women in technology, and the 2026 edition, themed The Power Shift, is a fully in-person day at Landmark Event Centre in Victoria Island on 26 September. Expect 2,500-plus attendees spanning founders, investors, hiring managers, and ecosystem leaders, all in one room for a single day.\n\nFor young women building in tech, or anyone recruiting, fundraising, or looking for a technical co-founder, the density of decision-makers at an event like this is hard to replicate any other way in Lagos. Registration is required and the event is free to attend."
    },
    {
      "category": "competitions",
      "title": "GTCO Squad Hackathon 3.0",
      "summary": "A national fintech hackathon from GTCO's Squad platform offering up to ₦10 million in cash prizes to student and developer teams.",
      "deadline": "Rolling",
      "eligibility": "Nigerian university students, developers, and early-stage startup teams",
      "apply_url": "https://squadco.com/hackathon/register/",
      "body_md": "GTCO Squad Hackathon is now in its third edition, run by Guaranty Trust Holding Company and its fintech arm HabariPay under the theme Smart Systems: The Intelligent Economy. Teams build data-driven solutions for how people and businesses interact with financial systems, and the top three placements split cash prizes worth up to ₦10 million, alongside mentorship and publicity.\n\nApplications are open now on Squad's official hackathon portal with no fixed closing date announced yet, which means the smart move is applying early rather than waiting. If you can code and have a fintech idea worth building, this is backed by one of Nigeria's largest financial institutions and comes with real distribution once you win."
    },
    {
      "category": "certifications",
      "title": "Digital Skills Nigeria: Free Microsoft Certification Vouchers",
      "summary": "A Microsoft-backed program giving Nigerian citizens free exam vouchers for Azure, Security, Power BI, and other Microsoft certifications after completing free coursework.",
      "deadline": "Rolling",
      "eligibility": "Nigerian citizens aged 16 to 35",
      "apply_url": "https://www.digitalskillsnigeria.org/",
      "body_md": "Digital Skills Nigeria, run in partnership with Tech4Dev and Microsoft, gives young Nigerians free access to learning tracks in cloud computing, data, and security, then rewards a passing mock-exam score (60% or higher, submitted by the 27th of the month) with a fully paid Microsoft certification exam voucher. Past cohorts have walked away certified as Azure Administrators, Azure Security Engineers, Azure Data Scientists, and Power BI Data Analysts, all at zero cost.\n\nThis is one of the few certification pipelines that pairs the learning material with the exam fee itself, which is usually the real barrier for students. Cohorts are reviewed monthly on a rolling basis, so you can start the coursework today and be sitting a proctored exam within weeks."
    }
  ]
}
